changes.title: Ambushers hunt
items: Spiders and snakes on the far side of their area now come for you once they've finished watching you, instead of waiting where they are

changes.title: Ley ahead
items: The leyline ahead of the pulse shows again: a dashed line in its own colour, the way on, while the line behind it is spent

changes.title: Ley early clear
items: Clearing an area early no longer makes the ley line's pulse jump ahead to its runestone: the pulse keeps its pace along the line, and the area's wave celebrates when it gets there
